1: # Tasks — `add-mcp-http-transport`
2: 
3: Waves reflect subagent parallelism. Each task lists the package(s) it
4: touches so waves don't collide. Parity tests in
5: `packages/adt-cli/tests/e2e/parity.*.test.ts` are mandatory for every
6: feature that ships a CLI command and an MCP tool.
7: 
8: ## Wave 0 — proposal + scaffold (sequential, lead)
9: 
10: - [ ] Write this OpenSpec change (`proposal.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md`,
11:       `specs/adt-mcp/spec.md`).
12: - [ ] Feature branch `feat/mcp-http-transport` off `main`.
13: - [ ] Confirm `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` ^1.27 is installed in
14:       `packages/adt-mcp/package.json`; add `zod` refinements util if
15:       missing.
16: - [ ] Add `MCP_HTTP_PORT`, `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN`, `MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS`,
17:       `MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, `MCP_SESSION_IDLE_MS`,
18:       `SAP_DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID`, `TRUST_FORWARDED_AUTH` to the
19:       `adt-mcp` README's configuration section as placeholders.
20: 
21: ## Wave 1 — HTTP transport, sessions, `sap_connect`, multi-system routing
22: 
23: Parallelisable subagents; all touch `packages/adt-mcp` and
24: `packages/adt-config`.
25: 
26: - [ ] **adt-mcp #http-entry** — `src/bin/adt-mcp.ts` transport switch:
27:       if `--http` / `MCP_HTTP_PORT`, start HTTP server; otherwise keep
28:       existing stdio path untouched.
29: - [ ] **adt-mcp #http-server** — new `src/lib/http/server.ts` that
30:       boots `node:http`, wires `hostHeaderValidation` + CORS, registers
31:       `POST /mcp`, `GET /mcp`, `DELETE /mcp` and delegates to
32:       `SessionRegistry`.
33: - [ ] **adt-mcp #session-registry** — new `src/lib/http/session-registry.ts`
34:       owning the `Map<id, McpSession>`, TTL sweeper, and `closeSession()`
35:       cleanup routine (release locks, DELETE SAP session,
36:       `transport.close()`).
37: - [ ] **adt-mcp #session-ctx** — new `ToolContext` variant that, when a
38:       session has an `AdtClient`, returns it from `getClient()` instead
39:       of constructing a fresh one per call. Stdio path keeps today's
40:       behaviour for backward compat.
41: - [ ] **adt-mcp #sap-connect-tool** — new `src/lib/tools/sap-connect.ts`
42:       implementing `sap_connect`, `sap_disconnect`, `sap_list_systems`.
43:       Input validated by Zod with a `systemId XOR inline creds`
44:       refinement.
45: - [ ] **adt-config #systems** — typed loader for `~/.adt/systems.yaml` + env `SAP_SYSTEMS` override; credentials always resolved from
46:       `SAP_<ID>_USERNAME` / `SAP_<ID>_PASSWORD` env vars, never from
47:       YAML.
48: - [ ] **adt-mcp #routing** — resolution helper that walks
49:       `arg → header x-sap-system-id → env → first configured` and
50:       returns a `ResolvedSystem` record.
51: - [ ] **adt-mcp #mock-http** — extend `src/lib/mock/server.ts` so the
52:       integration mock can be driven over HTTP (used by the new tests).
53: - [ ] **adt-mcp #http-tests** — `tests/http.integration.test.ts` covering
54:       session init, reuse, `sap_connect`, tool call, DELETE, and
55:       idle-TTL expiry.
56: 
57: ## Wave 2 — MCP-level auth
58: 
59: - [ ] **adt-mcp #auth-bearer** — `src/lib/http/auth.ts` middleware with
60:       `timingSafeEqual` compare against `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN`.
61: - [ ] **adt-mcp #auth-forwarded** — optional reverse-proxy mode under
62:       `TRUST_FORWARDED_AUTH=1` that trusts `x-forwarded-user`.
63: - [ ] **adt-mcp #auth-tests** — tests for missing token, wrong token,
64:       right token, disabled auth, and forwarded-auth paths.
65: - [ ] **adt-mcp #host-cors-tests** — host-header and CORS allow-list
66:       tests against a malicious `Host` header and a disallowed
67:       `Origin`.
68: 
69: ## Wave 3 — Transactional changesets (CLI + MCP + parity)
70: 
71: - [ ] **adt-cli #changeset-service** — new `ChangesetService` in
72:       `packages/adt-cli/src/lib/services/changeset/` with `begin`,
73:       `add`, `commit`, `rollback`; exported from
74:       `packages/adt-cli/src/index.ts`.
75: - [ ] **adt-cli #changeset-commands** — `adt changeset begin|add|commit|rollback`
76:       subcommands (thin wrappers, service pattern per
77:       `packages/adt-cli/AGENTS.md`).
78: - [ ] **adt-mcp #changeset-tools** — new
79:       `src/lib/tools/sap-changeset.ts` exposing
80:       `changeset_begin`, `changeset_add`,
81:       `changeset_commit`, `changeset_rollback`. Tools delegate
82:       to the CLI service — no business logic in the MCP package.
83: - [ ] **adt-mcp #changeset-registry** — session-scoped changeset state
84:       stored on `McpSession.changeset`; rejects nested begins.
85: - [ ] **parity #changeset** — `packages/adt-cli/tests/e2e/parity.changeset.test.ts`
86:       drives both the CLI subcommand and the MCP tool through the same
87:       mock server and asserts equivalent results for every
88:       begin/add/commit/rollback scenario.
89: 
90: ## Wave 4 — Okta / OIDC bearer (deferred / optional)
91: 
92: - [ ] **adt-mcp #oidc-middleware** — JWT verify via `jose`; issuer and
93:       audience configured by `MCP_OIDC_ISSUER` / `MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE`.
94:       JWKs fetched and cached per SDK `server/auth/*` helpers.
95: - [ ] **adt-mcp #oidc-tests** — tests with a disposable issuer
96:       (e.g. static JWK + signed JWT fixtures) — no live Okta.
97: - [ ] **adt-mcp #oidc-docs** — README section on Okta / Azure AD /
98:       Cognito setup, including scopes and audiences.
99: 
100: ## Wave 5 — Deployment artefacts + docs
101: 
102: - [ ] **adt-mcp #dockerfile** — `packages/adt-mcp/Dockerfile.mcp`,
103:       distroless Node, `BUN_CONFIG_REGISTRY` build arg for JFrog.
104: - [ ] **adt-mcp #compose** — `packages/adt-mcp/docker-compose.yml`
105:       with reverse-proxy + MCP service.
106: - [ ] **adt-mcp #readme** — rewrite README intro to cover HTTP +
107:       stdio, auth model, multi-system routing, Docker deploy,
108:       changeset workflow.
109: - [ ] **root AGENTS** — update the _MCP ↔ CLI Coupling_ section to
110:       call out HTTP transport and the changeset parity expectation.
111: - [ ] **adt-mcp AGENTS** — update invariant #4 per
112:       `specs/adt-mcp/spec.md` and add a new "Session model" section.
113: 
114: ## Wave 6 — Verification + PR (sequential, lead)
115: 
116: - [ ] `bunx nx run-many -t build,test,typecheck,lint -p adt-mcp,adt-cli,adt-config`
117: - [ ] `bunx nx format:write`
118: - [ ] Manual smoke test: `MCP_HTTP_PORT=3333 MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=dev bun packages/adt-mcp/src/bin/adt-mcp.ts`
119:       then drive with a Streamable-HTTP MCP client.
120: - [ ] Docker smoke test: `docker compose -f packages/adt-mcp/docker-compose.yml up --build`.
121: - [ ] Commit waves as separate commits; push feature branch; open PR
122:       cross-linking [#110](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/pull/110).
